function.header_comment:
/******************************************************************************
 * VarDateFromBool (OLEAUT32.96)
 *
 * Convert a VT_BOOL to a VT_DATE.
 *
 * PARAMS
 *  boolIn   [I] Source
 *  pdateOut [O] Destination
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  S_OK.
 */
